selection: frozen before current test evaluation; prior public test exposure disclosed
alpha_policy: same gate_alpha of the same uncertainty checkpoint across all three modes; validation only; alpha=0 explicitly disabled
rule: finite input + common availability/reset + validation quantile .99 of max normalized feature; no sigma cutoff
uncertainty: same rule + validation quantile .90 normalized sigma
anomaly_region: middle third; two-second cart/odom outages start at middle-third onset; boundaries independent of GT

odom_delay.timestamp_policy: delayed pose content, unchanged declared timestamps; hidden time misalignment; no future samples

odom_stale_stamp.description: visible stale timestamp; availability guard forces original-pose fallback

recovery_definition: first 3 consecutive active accepted samples after anomaly end; right censored if none; require changed fallbacks versus paired clean stream to claim anomaly-induced interruption
detection_definition: first fallback during affected region; clean paired fallback also measured so does not imply causal anomaly detection
evaluation: shared-map transform frozen from clean original input/GT anchor; evaluate same clean GT mask for all policies, no deleting corrupted intervals
scope: synthetic postprocessor-input anomalies on real recorded trajectories; lidar visibility and SLAM front/back end are unchanged
primary_harm_definition: error increase >0.05 m versus corresponding corrupted raw Cartographer input; also report versus clean original to separate input damage
